title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
abstract: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation within a single architecture. To enable scalable training, we construct an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, comprising 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M editing pairs generated using Nano3D-v2. Architecturally, the framework combines Hunyuan3D-VLM for semantic, structural, and spatial understanding with Hunyuan3D DiT for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The VLM provides multimodal semantic conditions for generation, while editing and part generation additionally condition the diffusion process on the source object representation to preserve its overall structure and unedited regions. Extensive experiments show that Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art or leading performance on text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks, while exhibiting strong understanding and part-generation capabilities. Our analysis further shows that both generation and understanding improve editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified 3D multimodal training. Project Page: https://tencent-hunyuan.github.io/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0/

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.02711v2 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 available（https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0）。
analysis.ideaZh: Buffalo 1.0 用共享 3D tokenizer 与 87M-scale multimodal corpus，把 3D understanding、text-to-3D、instruction editing 和 text-grounded part generation 放进同一 AR+DiT framework；作者报告 text-to-3D user study 中 overall preference 56.6%，但系统仍是多阶段 geometry pipeline，caption ambiguity、texture editing、mask consistency 与 data quality 被作者明确列为开放问题。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它是大规模统一 3D multimodal foundation model 的代表，直接覆盖生成、理解、编辑与 parts。
analysis.evidenceZh: Buffalo 统一支持 3D understanding、generation、editing 与 part generation，并共享模型接口。（Sec. 2 and Fig. 1, p. 2）；训练语料总计约 87M，分为 25M understanding、50M text-to-3D、10M editing 和 2M part generation。（Sec. 3 and Table 1, p. 8）；作者报告 text-to-3D user study 的 text alignment、geometry quality 与 overall preference 分别为 55.2%、57.1% 和 56.6%。（Table 5, p. 19）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：高质量 geometry 仍依赖多阶段生成，统一 single-stage representation 尚未解决。；作者限制：3D captions 由 MLLM 生成且有歧义，editing mask 内部一致性和 texture editing data 仍不足。；作者限制：3D data 的数量与质量均未达到理想规模。；审阅风险：87M examples 很多来自自动 caption/编辑管线，规模可能同时放大标注噪声和上游模型偏差。；审阅风险：user preference 不能替代 watertightness、topology 与可编辑性的工程验证。
analysis.motivationZh: 系统将 3D geometry 编码为离散/连续 latent interfaces：AR multimodal model 处理语言、理解、结构规划与部件条件，DiT 负责高保真 geometry generation。数据包括 25M understanding、50M text-to-3D、10M editing 与 2M part-generation samples，并通过分层 caption 和 Nano3D-v2 editing pipeline 统一训练。
analysis.methodZh: 系统将 3D geometry 编码为离散/连续 latent interfaces：AR multimodal model 处理语言、理解、结构规划与部件条件，DiT 负责高保真 geometry generation。数据包括 25M understanding、50M text-to-3D、10M editing 与 2M part-generation samples，并通过分层 caption 和 Nano3D-v2 editing pipeline 统一训练。 亮点是以大规模 task-mixed corpus 和共享 interface 做 3D foundation model，而非单个 SOTA module；但底层仍是 cascaded AR+DiT 与外部数据生成组件，不是完全单阶段统一表示。
analysis.experimentsZh: 分别在 UniPart-Bench、text-to-3D user study、Edit3D-Bench 和 part generation examples 上评估理解、生成、编辑和部件能力，并做 data-scale、caption tier 与 architecture analyses。 作者报告：作者报告 text-to-3D 四选一 user study 中 Buffalo 的 overall preference 为 56.6%，最强对照 Omni123 为 18.4%；50M data 版本 overall preference 为 57.5%。（Tables 5-6, p. 19） Baseline boundary：跨四类 3D tasks 比较 strong public systems，规模和定性覆盖广；但生成/编辑核心结果大量是 preference study 与自建数据协议，尚缺统一独立 benchmark。 Ablation boundary：分析 data scaling、caption tiers、understanding tasks 和 editing pipeline；缺少 compute-normalized model-size ablation、data contamination audit 与 texture/geometry joint modeling。
analysis.insightZh: 亮点是以大规模 task-mixed corpus 和共享 interface 做 3D foundation model，而非单个 SOTA module；但底层仍是 cascaded AR+DiT 与外部数据生成组件，不是完全单阶段统一表示。 任务统一、数据规模与公开 code 使其值得精读；需将作者 preference claims 与真实 geometry/texture 工程质量严格区分。
